mcq.q: Arun says: There is a vast generation gap between the teacher and students. How can something that is true for teacher be true for students too? Choose the most appropriate response.

options.A: We have to learn to live with the generation gap in any relationship
options.B: Life is about bridging the gaps which will always continue
options.C: There is no gap in the natural acceptance, it is the same for everyone
options.D: The students have to obey the teachers even if there is a gap

mcq.answer_text: There is no gap in the natural acceptance, it is the same for everyone

sq.q: What is meant by the experiencer in a human being?
answer: The Self is the experiencer, as it feels emotions like happiness, sadness, or satisfaction.

sq.q: Who is considered the knower in the human being?
answer: The Self is the knower, as it perceives and understands reality.

lq.q: Explain human being as the co-existence of Self and Body.
answer: A human being is the co-existence of Self and Body . The Self is the conscious entity, while the Body is the material entity. The Self is the one that desires, thinks, expects, understands, assumes and wants happiness. The Body is the physical instrument through which the Self performs activities such as eating, walking, speaking and working.

The Body is useful and necessary, but it is not the complete human being. The Self is central to human existence because the desire for continuous happiness exists in the Self. The Body is used by the Self as an instrument for living and participating in the world. Therefore, to understand a human being correctly, we must understand both the Self and the Body separately, and also understand their co-existence.

When we mistake the human being as only the Body, we try to fulfil every need through physical facility. This leads to confusion, accumulation and dissatisfaction. Right understanding begins when we see that the needs of the Self and the needs of the Body are different and must be fulfilled differently.
